1.1.2.5-f1.accuracy_reason: Entelechy as actuality is right, and Burton does gloss it with 'perfectio & actus primus' and then gives the English.

1.1.2.5-f16.accuracy_reason: Aristotle, De anima II.3 (414b), compares the nested faculties of soul to the triangle contained in the quadrilateral.

1.1.2.5-f9.accuracy_reason: Aeneid X.467–9 continues 'sed famam extendere factis, hoc virtutis opus', and Burton does break off before it.
